column1: # Drill canonicalization Phase 1 — the editorial decision for every curated row.
# THIS FILE IS THE DECISION, scripts/build-canon-audit.ts is only the join.
# One line per drill_resources row. A row missing from here fails the build of
# makes "zero rows may disappear from this audit" true rather than hopeful.
#   MERGE_INTO         activity                   yes  (family redundancy stops co-scheduling)
#   PRACTICE_UNIT      practice_unit              yes, on surfaces that support it
#   REVIEW_REQUIRED    (left NULL)                yes — unknown must not demote
# MERGE_INTO in Phase 1 means: both rows join ONE family, the canonical row is
# `base`. It does NOT mean a delete and does NOT hide the loser from the
# library — there is no duplicate_of column yet and history must still resolve.
# Library de-duplication is Phase 2. Said plainly so nobody reads a merge here
